pipeline.name: Ask
pipeline.detail: What, which style, what shape, how long, what sound, which characters. Only what your request left open, with a recommendation first. “You pick” gets a pick plus a one-line reason.

pipeline.name: Brief
pipeline.detail: A short brief file: kind, style (and why), shape(s), length, sound, characters, the one-sentence idea. Your words stay yours; its decisions are marked so you can veto them in one line.

pipeline.name: Story + grid
pipeline.detail: The story in three sentences (setup, transformation, payoff) plus the token that returns. Then the grid: at 120 bpm and 30 fps a beat is 15 frames, and one cue table holds every frame number, with a checker that runs at load.

pipeline.name: Reference
pipeline.detail: For anything that exists (animals, objects, people) it opens real reference and states the anatomy and the view. Hand-placed control points, never ellipses: a pear, not the icon of a pear.

pipeline.name: Look still
pipeline.detail: ONE still, the hardest frame, rendered at full size and at --scale 2, then a written critique and a detail pass on crops (faces, hands, feet, joins). This is the first approval. For a still, it is the only one.

pipeline.name: 8 s of music
pipeline.detail: One 8-second music sample. The model can't hear, so a person listens before the score is built out. It's recorded as confirmedBy in the file.

pipeline.name: Build
pipeline.detail: The whole piece, end to end. Mechanical checks (determinism, contract, dead air) run continuously; gates stop here because they would cost more than they save.

pipeline.name: Review once
pipeline.detail: A contact sheet per beat, each cut as a pair, the dead-air numbers. One ranked fix list, one rebuild.

pipeline.name: Final
pipeline.detail: Final approval, with an honest account: what was measured, what a human confirmed, and what can't be verified (it can't hear the score or watch the film move).

pipeline.name: Deliver
pipeline.detail: PNG, MP4 with score, GIF, WebM/APNG with alpha, one offline HTML player, an interactive module, WAV. Every shape from the same source; it says “reproducible” was printed.
